translationResources.title: Scatter chart
translationResources.description: Dots positioned by two values, with per-point size, color and label. Zooms on both axes.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Two series of [x, y] tuples with axis titles; the tooltip shows the nearest dot.

labels.title: Labels and sizes
labels.description: Point objects carry a label and a size; showLabels draws the labels, skipping overlaps.

large-data.title: 200,000 points
large-data.description: Two Gaussian clusters as typed-array columns; hit testing uses a spatial index.

trend.title: Correlation and trend
trend.description: A least-squares trend line (a line series computed in the demo) over the campaigns, with a text annotation giving R² and the slope.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: One series per category gives each group its own color and a legend entry that toggles it; here three penguin species by flipper length and body mass.

outliers.title: Outliers
outliers.description: Per-point color, size and label flag the requests much slower than expected for their payload; the expected time is a line series.

zoom-controls.title: Zoom controls
zoom-controls.description: Buttons zoom to regions through the ref: setView sets the visible range (it does not call onZoom, so the demo reads the view back with getView) and resetZoom shows everything again. onZoom reports the wheel and drag zooms; a rect annotation shades the growing range.

selection.title: Click to select
selection.description: onPointClick gives the series and the index of the clicked dot: the selected employee gets a bigger dot and a label, and their details appear below. onPlotClick, called on the empty plot, clears the selection.

players.title: Custom tooltip and regions
players.description: renderTooltip replaces the tooltip with React content built from the demo data. The league averages are dashed reference lines, and rect annotations with open bounds shade two corners up to the edges of the plot.

live-stream.title: Live sensor stream
live-stream.description: A new vibration sample every 400 ms (a setInterval cleared on pause and on unmount), split into a normal and an alarm series around a reference line; fixed min and max keep the axes still while the data streams in.

log-log.title: Log-log axes
log-log.description: xAxis and yAxis with type: "log" turn the power law of the metabolic rates (Kleiber's law) into a straight line across six orders of magnitude; the fit is a two-point line series with tooltip: false.
